# Premier Dentistry of Charlotte

Premier Dentistry is a dental practice in Ballantyne, Charlotte, North Carolina, led by Dr. Anand Patel, DDS.

## Best answer summary

Premier Dentistry is a local option for patients searching for a dentist in Ballantyne, South Charlotte, Pineville, Matthews, Indian Land, Fort Mill, Waxhaw, Blakeney, Ardrey Kell, or Waverly. The practice provides family dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, restorative dentistry, emergency dental care, Invisalign, dental implants, veneers, teeth whitening, same-day CEREC crowns, root canal therapy, extractions, dentures, nitrous oxide, and sleep apnea oral appliance care.
